snippet.title: R-Type Dimensions III Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience the return of a legendary shoot ’em up series in R-Type Dimensions III. Pilot advanced R-Craft fighters through intense side-scrolling battles, unleash devastating Force attacks, and survive waves of biomechanical enemies in a visually enhanced arcade experience. Classic gameplay meets modern presentation in the next evolution of the iconic R-Type saga.

Released on MAY 19th on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch™ 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox, and PC (Steam) in digital form. The physical Standard and Special Edition will launch on AUGUST 11.

BUT... If you have pre-ordered or will pre-order one of those physical versions, until it's release date, you will get an digital key for free (€9,99 on Nintendo Platforms) that give you the full game already! 

How does this work? Here are all the informations:
https://iningames.com/blogs/news/r-type-dimensions-iii-pilot-briefing

R-Type Dimensions III continues the franchise’s tradition of intense, precision-based shoot-’em-up action, bringing together classic 2D design and modernized visuals for a new generation of pilots — while remaining faithful to the series’ iconic DNA.

Key features include:
● A fully remastered experience with completely reconstructed assets
● Local co-op, enhanced with new scoring and survival mechanics
● Customizable controls and quality-of-life features in the settings
● 3D Camera settings (normal and crazy)

More information on http://www.iningames.com
